about: The Brood's sounds (docs/creatures.md, docs/mmorpg-m8.md N1, 2026-10-14): per kind an idle chitter, an attack, a hurt and a death; the Lodeback's chew while it mines; the Matriarch's roar, slam and spit; broodswarm, a swarm coming (the raid warning). Takes are made into unreal/server/build/n1/takes, all kept in art/models/<kind>/sounds/; the picks are copied to unreal/Resources/Sounds/sfx/<stem>_<n>.wav (docs/creatures.md, "Sounds", lists them). Organic chitin and insect sounds, no voices, no music; checked offline (Tools/Audio/check_sounds.py), never played aloud.
